title: Harvey
text:
Everyone knows who Richard Rusczyk is. Well, this is a page dedicated to the "man", the myth, the "man" and the myth who carries Richard Rusczyk, HARVEY!

1. In Rusczyk's short videos, which are called "Mathcounts Minis", Harvey often "appears" in the videos, often carrying Rusczyk, jumping in when even the awesome Rusczyk couldn't solve the problem.

2. There is widespread controversy about whether Harvey actually exists, because his face never is shown in the Mathcounts minis.

3. He also periodically "appears" in Rusczyk's other videos, primarily to help with geometry-related problems. According to Rusczyk, Harvey can see things that Rusczyk himself can't see.

--I'm editing this because I think Prof. Harold Reiter is the inspiration for Harvey because he is in the acknowledgements and has a name similar to Harvey.
